title: VWP-Bench answer key
description: The private, per-challenge expected values for keyed items, including documented acceptable alternatives. Held out until results publish; consumed by tools/score-key.mjs.

authors.description: The two independent key authors plus the external technical reviewer, per DESIGN.md §5.3.

slot.description: Matches a slot in the challenge's required-facts manifest.

expected.description: Expected value, in the slot's declared value shape.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance for numeric comparison (money amounts, quantities). Default 0.01.

basis.description: The position under which this alternative is acceptable.

requiredDocumentation.description: What the work product must document for this alternative to earn credit.

alternatives.description: Acceptable alternative positions where US GAAP genuinely admits them.

rationale.description: Why the expected value is correct; standard citations.
